description.fun: A cyborg sumo wrestler that looks a lot like Hariyama, with fists said to move independently of its body and to be strong enough to throw speeding vehicles. Before attacking it presses its glowing palm panels together, maybe a nod to defibrillators and to Hariyama's move Smelling Salts, called 'Resuscitation' in Japan. A paranormal magazine claimed it was once an injured athlete kept alive as a cyborg.
description.guide: A Fighting and Electric-type Paradox Pokémon found in Pokémon Violet, said to be either a future relative of Hariyama or a version of it from a parallel timeline. It resembles a futuristic sumo wrestler and releases energy from the panels in its palms.
description.tagline: A cyborg Hariyama built like a futuristic sumo wrestler
